findings.issue: TDD Anchor section is entirely absent. T5 is unambiguously a code task (replaces ~440 lines of JS in index.html: state, escape utilities, srcdoc builder, lazy lib materialization, 5 setters, message listener). Per template, TDD Anchor is required for code tasks; the analogous code tasks T1/T3/T4 in the same batch do include a TDD Anchor section with intended/deferred tests per Decision 9. Verification Steps → Automated also notes 'TDD anchors below describe what would be tested if the test target existed' — but no such anchors block exists.
findings.fix: Add a `## TDD Anchor` section between `## What to do` (line 60) and `## Acceptance Criteria` (line 61). Mirror the pattern used in T1/T3/T4: list intended deferred tests in `Tests/InsightV2WebTests::test_xxx` style entries, each with `path::test_name — what it verifies` format. Suggested coverage based on AC: postMessage allowlist (5 types accepted, others rejected), event.source/origin validation, deepDive payload bounds (sectionId membership + topicIndex bounds), breadcrumb UUID regex, escapeForHTMLAttribute/escapeForHTMLText behavior, CDN-strip regex (https/http/protocol-relative + link rel=prefetch/preconnect/dns-prefetch), blob URL revoke-on-navigation diff, releaseInsightBlobs full revoke, 10s iframe load timeout firing setInsightError, lazy lib selection from skeleton (Mermaid only when section.type === 'mermaidDiagram', etc.).

findings.issue: Last AC item is 'Все 3 ревью (code-reviewer, security-auditor, test-reviewer) дали approve в декларации round-1 (или пройдены ≤3 раунда правок)'. This is a process meta-criterion (review status), not a verifiable feature/behavior. ACs should be testable behaviors of the artifact, not orchestration outcomes — review acceptance is governed by feature-execution, not by the task itself.
findings.fix: Remove this AC item — review status is enforced by the do-task flow, not by the task's own acceptance criteria. Replace, if useful, with a behavior criterion (e.g. 'No new warnings introduced into GraphRAG.swift / InsightModels.swift compile output').

findings.issue: Required Skills uses English 'Before starting, load:' header line, while T1, T2, T4, T5 use Russian 'Перед выполнением задачи загрузи:'. Project's CLAUDE.md states 'Always use English in files or comments'; under that rule the Russian template line is itself non-conformant, but consistency within a batch matters either way.
findings.fix: Align all five tasks to a single language for the loader prompt — either Russian (matching the template default) or English (matching project CLAUDE.md). Recommend English to satisfy CLAUDE.md, updating T1/T2/T4/T5 to match T3.
